guard.note: HEAD of ClientChunkCache.drop, cancels it; for a shipyard chunk removes it from vs$shipChunks (the wrapped LongObjectMap.remove), unloads its render view and sends delete terrain updates; never unloads its block entities
@Unique, merged under its own name: removes the chunk from vs$shipChunks (the wrapped call) and unloads its render view; never unloads its block entities
ShipUnloadEventClient: removeShipChunk for every chunk of the ship's claim
a shipyard chunk still in vs$shipChunks is refilled (replaceWithPacketData clears its block entities first); one that is not is built anew: new block entities, new tickers

priority 1500 HEAD cancel of LevelChunk.clearAllBlockEntities: onChunkUnloaded, then setRemoved, on a snapshot of the block entities; tickers rebound to the no-op ticker on a snapshot; both maps cleared
clearAllBlockEntities, the call the helper makes
unload: clearAllBlockEntities, then light and entity sections; the block-entity part is what the switch restores for ship chunks
drop: ChunkEvent.Unload, then Storage.replace(i, chunk, null) -> ClientLevel.unload

valkyrien_client_ship_chunk_unload.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the LongObjectMap.remove(J) call in Valkyrien Skies' MixinClientChunkCache.preUnload (MixinSquared @TargetHandler) and in its merged removeShipChunk (named directly; priority 1500 after VS's 1000): the call runs unchanged and the LevelChunk it returns, if any, gets LevelChunk.clearAllBlockEntities (m_187957_), the block-entity part of ClientLevel.unload; helper bons.furious.patch.valkyrien_client_chunks.ShipChunkUnload (runtime flag valkyrienClientShipChunkUnload, shadow check of the level's ticker lists through the accessor mixin LevelTickerListsAccessor). Fix: ghost block-entity tickers of reloaded ship chunks.

the classification VS's handler makes first and the helper makes again (pure: a coordinate range test)
drop, which now runs for world chunks: in range and still the chunk at that position -> ChunkEvent.Unload, then Storage.replace(i, chunk, null)

unload: clearAllBlockEntities, light off for the column, entity sections stop ticking

valkyrien_client_chunk_drop.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the CallbackInfo.cancel() call in Valkyrien Skies' MixinClientChunkCache.preUnload (MixinSquared @TargetHandler, priority 1500; the handler's chunkX/chunkZ arguments read with MixinExtras @Local): the cancel is made as before for a shipyard chunk (VSGameUtilsKt.isChunkInShipyard, the test VS makes first) and skipped for any other chunk, so ClientChunkCache.drop continues into Minecraft's own code; helper bons.furious.patch.valkyrien_client_chunks.WorldChunkDrop (runtime flag valkyrienClientChunkDrop, shadow check that each dropped world chunk left the client's chunk array without block entities). Fix: world chunks the server forgets are never unloaded on a Valkyrien Skies client (no client ChunkEvent.Unload, their block entities keep ticking).
